citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
The animals on exhibit did not match the animals listed on the itinerary submitted for this event. The submitted itinerary
listed two California sea lions, however, one California sea lion and one South American sea lion were on exhibit. The
facility representative stated that the change in animals was made after the itinerary was submitted. A corrected itinerary
was not submitted to APHIS. An accurate itinerary is necessary to ensure Animal Care can properly track the movement
of animals and ensure animal welfare and compliance with the Animal Welfare Act.. After submission the itinerary shall be
revised as necessary and the Deputy Adminstrator shall be notified of any changes. To be corrected by October 6, 2026.
This inspection was conducted at the Middle Tennessee District Fair in Lawrenceburg, TN. This inspection and exit
interview were conducted with a facility representative.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
